name: Alex Rivera
tagline: I turn a pile of sales tools into one system
that tells each rep what to do next, and why.
ticker: Lead to first touch: 2 days to 9 minutes
Forecast built from data, not gut feel
Every account scored before the stand-up
One record per company, across every tool

pillars.title: Clean data
pillars.text: One record per company. Dedupe, enrich and keep it that way with rules that run every night.

pillars.title: Signals
pillars.text: Product usage, email and web activity scored with decay, so old noise drops off.

pillars.title: Routing
pillars.text: Inbound leads reach the right owner in minutes, with guards for live deals and opt-outs.

pillars.title: Forecast
pillars.text: Stage gates with entry and exit rules, so the pipeline number means something.

pillars.title: Automation
pillars.text: Scripts and agents that do the busywork, each one tested read-only first.

work.title: Signal scoring
work.text: Nightly account scores with decay and a plain-English reason for each one.

work.title: Lead router
work.text: Domain and name matching, deal-owner guards and SLA timers for every inbound lead.

work.title: Record cleanup
work.text: Rules-first dedupe across every tool, with a backup before each merge.

work.title: Forecast model
work.text: Stage gates and weighted pipeline rebuilt so the commit number holds up.

work.title: Rep brief
work.text: A morning email per rep: who to call, the signal behind it, the last touch.

work.title: Profile kit
work.text: The generator that drew every card on this page, light and dark.
